## @stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-tab 0.6.0

This release adds a native **DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 Host Schedule mode** while preserving the existing projection-based compatibility path for older supported DSH releases.

### Native RC2 task catalog

- Uses the authoritative cross-session `schedule.catalog()` Host task catalog.
- Refreshes from the native `schedule/changed` event.
- Keeps the existing source-Session navigation and notification-style sidebar counters.
- Active sidebar counts exclude retained inactive tasks.

### Task management

- **Delete** tasks through native `schedule.delete()`.
- **Edit** active task title, reminder prompt, and timing through native compare-and-update `schedule.update()`.
- Change timing between one-shot, Every, Daily, Weekly, and Cron rules.
- Daily/Weekly/Cron editors preserve explicit IANA time zones.
- Shows an explicit **Recurring** tag and a rule-kind badge.

### Delivery history

- Loads saved delivery receipts through native paged `schedule.history()`.
- Shows scheduled time, durable delivery time, and the prompt snapshot recorded for that occurrence.
- Labels the feature **Delivery history** because DSH receipts acknowledge inbox delivery, not successful Agent execution.
- Surfaces DSH retention/pruning notices when older records are unavailable.

### Retained task states

- Adds **Active / All / Inactive / Today / Overdue / Recurring** filtering.
- Retained inactive one-shot tasks remain inspectable.
- Shows the latest durable delivery time from `lastDelivery`.
- Daily, Weekly, and Cron frequencies are formatted with their wall-clock rule and time zone.

### Compatibility

- DSH `0.1.5-rc.3`: projection compatibility mode.
- DSH `0.1.7-rc.1`: projection compatibility mode.
- DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`: full Host Schedule control center.
- Peer range: `>=0.1.5-rc.3 <0.1.7-rc.3`.

### Verification

- Client regression scenarios cover RC2 catalog authority, realtime invalidation, inactive tasks, Daily/Weekly/Cron formatting, native deletion, native history, and native compare-and-update editing.
- CI installation smoke covers `0.1.5-rc.3`, `0.1.7-rc.1`, and `0.1.7-rc.2`.
